reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI skin that adds selectable or imported wallpapers, configurable wallpaper opacity, and an optional liquid-glass blur overlay while preserving the official layout and scrolling behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加可选或自定义壁纸、壁纸透明度及可开关的液态玻璃模糊效果。
summaries.en: Adds selectable or custom wallpapers, wallpaper opacity control, and an optional liquid-glass blur effect to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI appearance
adds configurable wallpaper opacity and glass blur settings
injects CSS for visual overlays and interface surfaces
